run_backfill_dataset: run a full backfill of a dataset by analyzing its state and creating missing jobs across all processing steps
finish_job_and_trigger_next: finish a processing job, store its result in the cache, and trigger the next steps in the processing graph
remove_dataset_from_viewer: remove a dataset from the dataset viewer by deleting its jobs, cache entries, storage directories, and ref branches
smart_update_dataset_revision: smartly update a dataset revision by detecting only non-significant changes and updating cache without recomputing
check_pending_ancestor_jobs: check if a processing step or any of its ancestors have pending jobs to determine if an artifact could exist soon
